questions.e: In the video: "Sutra je Sveta Petka" — tomorrow is Saint Petka's day.

questions.q: On what date is the holiday marked?
questions.e: In the video: "Srpska pravoslavna crkva 27. oktobra obeležava Svetu Petku" — the Serbian Orthodox Church marks Saint Petka on 27 October.

questions.q: What should be avoided on this day according to folk belief?
questions.e: In the video: "trebalo bi izbegavati teške fizičke i kućne poslove" — one should avoid heavy physical and household chores.
In the video: "Posebno se pominju pranje veša, šivenje, predenje i tkanje" — washing laundry, sewing, spinning and weaving are especially mentioned.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: jednu od najpoštovanijih *svetiteljki* u našem narodu
questions.e: Svetiteljka — a female saint; svetiteljki — gen. pl.

questions.q: Za ovaj praznik *vezuju* se brojni običaji
questions.e: Vezivati se — to be tied; vezuju se — are tied.

questions.q: može doneti nesreću, bolest ili *nemir* porodici

questions.e: Obeležava (what?) is a direct object, accusative: Petku.

questions.q: jednu od najpoštovanijih svetiteljki u našem ___
questions.e: The preposition u ("in, among") answering "where?" takes the locative: u našem narodu.

questions.q: prema narodnom ___ tog dana trebalo bi izbegavati
questions.e: The preposition prema ("according to") takes the dative: prema verovanju.
